notes.title: Patch 1.1: Weapons Workbench
notes.content:
NEW WEAPONS

While CRUX's Unholy Trinity provides solutions to every range of engagement, there's other ways to provide these solutions. So, more weapons that provide these different solutions are here!
You'll still be limited to 3 weapons, but you can swap your guns for new guns within the same class.
The new weapons will be unlocked by default for everyone. The aim is not to provide better weapons, but rather different, equally strong, options to suit different playstyles and different perk loadouts.

The classes are as follows:
Ballistic: Shotgun
Energy: Plasma Rifle
Explosive: Rocket Launcher

If you head to the Weapons Workbench in the Blood Temple, you'll find our...

NEW WEAPONS!

Flakker (Ballistic)
The Flakker is an explosive shotgun that provides a new way of dealing with waves, and synergizes with different perks.
Primary Fire: 7-pellet pattern dealing 70dmg + 175aoe
Secondary: Single grenade which explodes after 18 meters dealing 60dmg + 160aoe in a small radius

Blaster (Ballistic)
The Shotvolver is a hybrid between a shotgun and a revolver, great for the sharpshooters out there who can click on heads better than anyone out there.
Primary: 4-pellet pattern dealing 120dmg
Secondary: Slug shell dealing 80dmg with a 3x headshot multiplier

Thunderbolt (Energy)
The LG is a powerhouse of single target damage. Instead of firing projectiles, it fires a straight lightning strike continuously dealing huge damage.
Primary: Continuous beam dealing 450DPS with 18m range
Secondary: Heat Blast that deals huge area damage in a short range, but can only be fired when the LG is at maximum heat!

Plasma Carbine (Energy)
The Plasma Launcher transforms the energy weapon slot into an sniping machine.
Primary: large slow projectiles dealing 50dmg+30aoe
Secondary: a wide piercing projectile that cleaves through enemies and deals damage over time

Pulverizer (Explosive)
Rapid fire explosives that let you spread out the explosions everywhere!
Primary: Rapid fire rockets dealing 25dmg+45aoe
Secondary: Slow projectile that deals continuous damage to everything in its path

Grenadier (Explosive)
Grenade launcher meets burst rifle?
Primary: Three grenades shot in quick succession dealing 30dmg+45aoe
Secondary: Sticky grenades which sticks to enemies and environments and continuously explodes over a period of time

Other changes:

Rocket Launcher
Remote detonation now increases area damage of the rocket from 80 to 130

notes.title: v0.9 POWERSLAVE
notes.content:
CRUX is nearing version v1.0 and with it new features are being added. First off, we're happy to announce that CRUX now supports multiple languages in-game!

Along with that multiple new perks have been added to the game, allowing players more options to better express their favorite playstyle.

And finally, the next 3 arenas have been finished. While these are not included in the demo, we hope you're excited to try them out in the upcoming release of CRUX!

CRUX Patch v0.9: POWERSLAVE

Added Language Localization for the following languages:
[olist]
 Spanish
 French
 German
 Russian
 Portuguese
[/olist]

New PERKS

Combo Killer
Receive a damage boost lasting 1 second after switching weapons

Motherlode
Spawn lava/thermite pools that last 5 seconds on area damage

Ranger
Reduced self damage. Rocket Jump away!

Dashmaster
Increased dash distance

Electrified
Whenever you headshot an enemy lightning hits 1-4 enemies dealing 20 damage per lightning strike

Changed Perks

Blood Covenant
Added VFX

Bulletsmith
Reworked. Now generates a flat 5% of max ammo every 5/4/3 seconds. Legendary generates 10% every 3s.

Dash Protection
Reworked: Now grants damage reduction after dashing

Grace
Reworked: Now grants damage reduction for 1s after taking damage

Nature's Blessing
Nerf: Healing tick rate reduced from every second to every 5 seconds

Hex
Added VFX

Hollow Points
Added VFX

Pungent
Added VFX

Ricochet
Added VFX

Skullcrusher
Added VFX

Trail Blazer
Improved fire VFX

New LEVELS (POWERSLAVE)

After clearing the Catacombs, the unholy portal takes you into the crossroads of dimensions, where the damned gather to praise the blood gods.

SAND PITS
You drop into the sandy moat guarding the Ziggurat. Sand worms, blood flies and the unholy guardian, the Giant Sandworm will try and prevent you from reaching the heights of the Ziggurat.

MARKET
The damned have gathered from across dimensions to witness the ritual of the Void, where souls will be fed into the well that feeds the blood gods. The hordes of the damned and the Wereguardians of the Void guard the steps of the Ziggurat where the ritual is taking place, and they will try to stop you from reaching the top.

ZIGGURAT
Once you reach the top of the Ziggurat you find the Void Priest conducting the soul feeding ritual. Overcome the soul magic to break free of the Ziggurat's void prison, interrupt the ritual, and take the portal into the next step of your journey into the CRUX.

General Changes


 Weapon recovery time reduced to 0.2 seconds after equipping
 Health pickups now heal for 25HP and recover in 30 seconds
 Armor pickups now heal for 25AP and recover in 30 seconds
 Ammo pickups now give 4/20/4 ammo respectively
 Ammo pickup recovery time is now 10 seconds

notes.title: CRUX 0.7: Antechamber Overhaul
notes.content:
Following a large influx of players during last June's Steam NextFest, there was a large influx of feedback as well, especially regarding the sense of progression and system feedback. This patch is focused on responding to the most pressing concerns raised by players.

Levels

Previously, CRUX had arenas with many waves and boss encounters meant to last ~15 minutes to complete. This allowed players to learn all the traversal options of the arena during a single encounter. However, this also failed to give a sense of progression. Going forward arenas will have much fewer encounters, a single boss encounter, and will take much less time to complete. To compensate, more arenas will be added, starting with section 1: Antechamber.


 Added new Arena: Antechamber-1
 Added new Arena: Antechamber-2
 Original Antechamber arena is now Antechamber-3, and it picks up from after the second boss fight.


The Free Demo includes all 3 of these levels.

Demons

New demon: Goblin Sniper (Antechamber)
The Goblin Sniper fills the role of a ranged lower-health opponent which was missing. It has one single attack: sniping with its slingshot. But it will try to keep away from you while doing so.

Gorgon

Added: Freezing Scream
Mid range attack, that does low damage, but temporarily slows you down.

Added: Sky Barrage
Boss Only. Phanaixe, the Gorgon boss of Antechamber-2, will occasionally shoot into the air, and a barrage of arrows will crash down to the ground.

Rock Golem

Added: Ground Eruption
Mid range attack, the Golem will hit the ground causing rock spikes to come out of the ground in a line in front of it, dealing damage and stunning you.

Systems Feedback


 Changed hit marker sounds
 Added additional blood effects on enemy hits
 Added directional damage indicators, showing which direction damage was taken from
 Added missile warning indicators, showing which direction projectiles are coming from
 Added floating damage numbers above enemies
 Changed screen shake algorithm to be smoother
 Added sound effect on enemy kills
 Added sound effect on jump pad use
 Added player footstep sound effects
 Added enemy footstep sound effects
 Added enemy footstep particle effects
 Added enemy outlines to improve visibility in darker areas and foliage
 Improved lighting contrast


Quality of Life


 Added invert mouse option
 Renamed Controls menu to Bindings menu
 Reduced hold time for Perk Selection

notes.title: March Update
notes.content:
CRUX is an arena shooter wave fighting roguelike. As such, it needs more arenas, more enemies, and more player abilities.

While, we're still in closed testing, we're happy to announce that that's exactly what we're bringing.
Level 2: Catacombs
We've been testing Level 1: Antechamber for a while now, and we're pretty excited to continue our adventure into the Catacombs.
Catacombs is a much flatter and more cramped space, forcing the player to use its pillars of bones and skulls for cover to the fullest.
While the Catacombs is meant to be the second level of Crux, for testing purposes in this patch it will be the first level. From the next patch it will take its place after the Antechamber.
New Enemies
Skeleton Knight
The Skeleton Knight is a fodder enemy that you'll see plenty of. While it has mostly a simple move set of trying to kill you with its sword, it can also go into a defensive stance whereby it reflects attacks with its shield.
Exploder
The Exploder is an infected corpse, devoid of mind, only craving to explode, so keep your distance!
Undead Warrior
The washed up bodies of ancient Varangian warriors, reanimated through the arcane, thirsting for blood. Keep away from their axes, but eliminate them quickly, lest they go into their berserk rage.
Bone Golem
Rock Golems obsessed with bones and dark magic. The bones they wear grant them extra protection, and the ethereal bone magic they cast grants them destruction
Mummy 
Laid to rest eons ago, angry at their forced reanimation, mummies will try to pull you into the other side with them
Undead Mage
Varangian shamans who accompanied their Warrior brethren. Calm, powerful and thirsty for souls.
The Reaper
The final guardian of the Catacombs, wielding the power of its ethereal scythe and all the souls it has collected over eons. Defeat them to gain access to the next arena (once it has been developed, of course).
